name: sotto
description: Search and read your recorded conversations. Recorded, transcribed and stored on your Mac.
long_description: Sotto is a free, open-source notetaker for macOS. It records calls (your microphone and the computer's audio as separate tracks) or in-person meetings, then transcribes them on your Mac with speaker labels. This extension lets Claude list, search and read those transcripts, name speakers, and start or stop a recording in the Sotto app. Transcripts never leave your Mac except for the parts Claude reads to answer you.

tools.name: list_recordings
tools.description: List recordings by date, newest first.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Read one transcript with timestamps and speakers.

tools.name: rename_speaker
tools.description: Name a speaker; Sotto remembers the voice.

tools.name: recording_status
tools.description: Whether Sotto is recording right now.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Start a recording in the Sotto app.
